name: Bond
source:
The void is a strange place, filled with a strange creature that seems to be a reflection of yourself, and an even stranger being that is always overhead but can never be seen. Of course, you wouldn't know about that-- despite your weeks floating in the void, you have never opened your eyes to the world around you.

Today, that changes.

[From [url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/bond]itch.io[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
虚空是一个奇怪的地方，充满了一种奇怪的生物，它似乎是你自己的倒影，还有一种更奇怪的存在，它总是在头顶上，但永远看不见。当然，你不会知道这一点——尽管你在虚空中漂浮了数周，但你从未睁开眼睛看看周围的世界。

今天，情况发生了变化。

[来自[url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/bond]itch.io[/url]]

为NaNoRenO 2015创建。
